meta.title: A bid revised after the award was prepared must be re-awarded

steps.note: Open the prepared award proposal that contains Vendor A's earlier bid.
Move to Vendor A's supplier portal without closing the buyer session.
Open the prepared event's pricing round so Vendor A can revise the bid.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid while bidding is reopened.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the revised bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's prepared award proposal.
Attempt to submit the award prepared before the bid revision.
Verify Procol refuses the stale award and reports that the bid was revised or must be re-awarded.
